S1Q01.reason: Correct XGBoost rationale for messy tabular data plus a sensible logistic-regression baseline, spoken at a natural length.

S1Q02.reason: Arithmetic is right end to end: 9,500 churners, 3,000 true positives, 31.6 percent recall, consistent with the claim.

S1Q03.reason: Holdout plus difference-in-differences is the right design, but the raw LaTeX percent markup cannot be read aloud.

S1Q04.reason: Covers every edge case asked, but claiming lift of one with no positive labels is wrong and recall is left hedged.

S1Q05.reason: Chronological split with an embargo gap and a ColumnTransformer fitted on train only is exactly the leakage-safe answer.

S1Q06.reason: Puts the event type filter in the where clause, which turns the left join into an inner join and drops zero-call customers.

S1Q07.reason: Covers every stage and names the shared feature and model artifacts, but runs far past a spoken length.

S1Q08.reason: Says it filters out control data where offers were shown then relies on the control group; contradictory and mislabels treatment.

S1Q09.reason: Sound Azure mapping, but Azure API Gateway is not a service; also well over a spoken length.

S1Q10.reason: Managed identity, RBAC, Key Vault and per-environment isolation are all correct; only the length needs trimming.

S2Q01.reason: Walks every stage accurately and maps it to the experience, but well over a spoken length.

S2Q02.reason: Defines unit, denominator, dataset and uncertainty, but conflates a Wilson interval with seed variance and the LaTeX markup is unspeakable.

S2Q04.reason: Reciprocal rank fusion scoring, one-based ranks and id tie-break are all right; stray dollar-sign artifacts need editing.

S2Q05.reason: Greedy relevance-first with dedup, per-document cap and budget skip matches the spec exactly, but exceeds a spoken length.

S2Q06.reason: Claims a worker pool with a counter then describes fixed batches of eight; contradictory concurrency mechanism, though timeout and failure isolation are right.

S2Q07.reason: Index, metadata, permissions and evaluation are covered, but the required deletions are never handled and keys sit in the metadata store.

S2Q08.reason: Dual write, backfill with CDC replay, shadow comparison, cutover and column-level rollback are all correct, but too long.

S2Q09.reason: Every Azure service choice is apt and the managed-versus-custom line is well drawn; over a spoken length.
